Infrastructure as Code • AWS • Automation

Infrastructure Engineer & Team Lead focused on reliable, secure cloud platforms with Terraform, AWS, and automation.

I'm James Shaw, an Infrastructure Engineer and current Infrastructure Team Lead with 8+ years across cloud, automation, and systems administration. I specialise in AWS, Terraform, Windows & SQL Server, and monitoring—driving automation-first, security-first practices.

This website runs on AWS ECS.

AWS (EC2, VPC, ALB, Route53, IAM) Azure (VMs, PIM, FrontDoor, NSGs/Firewalls, AKS) Terraform & Ansible Windows Server 2019-2022 (CIS L1) SQL Server Clustering Monitoring: Elastic, Grafana, Zabbix, Splunk Octopus Deploy • CI/CD

Core Skills

Cloud & IaC

AWS (EC2, VPC, ALB, Route53, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, etc)

Azure (VMs, PIM, FrontDoor, NSGs/Firewalls, AKS, etc)

Terraform modules & state management, Ansible automation, Octopus Deploy.

Version control with GitHub/Bitbucket; policy-driven change management.

Systems & Databases

Windows Server 2019-2022 (CIS L1), Active Directory, SQL Server clustering lifecycle (design, build, manage and decommission), Linux Ubuntu 24.04 admin.

Automation & Scripting

PowerShell (strong), Bash (Beginner), Python (developing). CI/CD release management, security-first patterns (TLS, VPNs, proxies, SOPs).

Monitoring & DR

ElasticSearch, Grafana, Corelogix, Zabbix, Splunk. Backups & DR with Bacula, Commvault, Veritas; AWS DLM policies.

Project Work

Automation of Infrastructure Builds

Standardised Terraform & Ansible workflows to accelerate and harden provisioning across environments at Creovai.

Browse public repository →

SQL Server Clustering

Designed, deployed, and maintained SQL Server clusters end-to-end with robust backup, monitoring, and security baselines.

Proxmox VE + Kubernetes (k3s) Cluster

Built a production-style homelab on Proxmox: 1 master + 2 workers, hosting multiple apps. Fully automated with Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and SOPS.

What's running
  • Public personal CV site with modern, accessible design.
  • BookStack for documenting projects and runbooks.
  • Cloudflare DNS for domain management to static IP.
  • Cloudflare Tunnel for secure ingress via Cloudflare's edge (no ISP port-forwarding).
Automation stack
  • Terraform: Proxmox VMs, Cloudflare DNS, and Zero Trust tunnel.
  • Ansible: End-to-end k3s install & node configuration.
  • Helm + Bash: App deployment (BookStack, CV site, etc.).
  • SOPS: Encrypted secrets management.
Resilience
  • Rebuild the entire environment from scratch in a few hours.
  • Automated BookStack DB exports to local WSL; version-controlled in GitHub.

Experience

  1. Infrastructure Team Lead — Creovai (formerly Awaken Intelligence), Remote (Mar 2025 – Present)
    Lead infra operations, manage overseas engineers, optimise on-call, mentor team, and drive automation-first practices.
  2. Infrastructure Engineer — Creovai (formerly Awaken Intelligence), Remote (Dec 2020 – Feb 2025)
    Automated infrastructure with Terraform & Ansible; designed SQL Server clusters; maintained Windows Server 2022 (CIS L1); monitoring (Elastic, Grafana, Corelogix); AWS DLM backups; Octopus Deploy; security-first designs with TLS, proxies & VPNs.
  3. 1st Line Support Engineer — BCN Group, Manchester (Aug 2020 – Dec 2020)
    Frontline support, M365 admin, remote installs and triage.
  4. IT Support Engineer — Cloud53, Manchester (Nov 2019 – Jul 2020)
    1st–3rd line support, Windows Servers/AD/Exchange, WatchGuard firewalls, monitoring.
  5. Technical Support Engineer — UKFast, Manchester (Jun 2018 – Oct 2019)
    Supported Linux & Windows, VMware/Hyper-V, enterprise backups (Bacula, Commvault), documentation, Grafana & Zabbix.
  6. Service Delivery Specialist — Secure Information Assurance, Manchester (Nov 2016 – Jun 2018)
    Infrastructure support in security-focused environments; Zabbix & Splunk; Veritas Backup; Sophos AV; monthly service reports.

Training & Development

  • Proxmox home lab for Kubernetes, Ansible, Jenkins, and Python.
  • Exploring Python automation projects and networking.
